current.text: Wiggins signed a 2-year, 64 million USD extension with Miami plus a player option, on top of 30 million USD this season.
He is a lock to start for Miami next to Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo.
Miami traded for Giannis Antetokounmpo. Wiggins is now the third option behind Giannis and Bam Adebayo, and Giannis may run point.
Experts expect his usage, already under 20, to drop with Giannis on the team, so he probably does a bit less this year.
His minutes were around 28 to 29 a night over the final couple of months of last season.
One expert does not buy last season's three-point shooting (41% overall, 47% over the last 20 games) or his steal and block rates repeating next to Giannis.
Experts call him a safe, solid tier 7 pick with little upside and little downside. One ranks him above Tobias Harris and Aaron Gordon at power forward.
Experts say he is overpriced around pick 78 to 95 and not worth a top 100 pick. He is fine around pick 107 to 109, and around pick 120 one expert would rather take upside flyers.
Miami has a weak 4-3-3 schedule in our fantasy playoff weeks, 10 games in total.
Miami has the league-minimum 13 back-to-backs and none in the fantasy playoffs.
The East is very stacked, so Miami may not be able to rest players for long stretches.

note: Wiggins is a late, low-cost starter. Yahoo values him at 5 USD and ESPN at 4 USD, and he went for 4 USD in our auction last season. Experts put him around pick 107 to 120, below his Yahoo rank of 93 and ESPN rank of 85, so do not go above a few USD. No category is weak, so he fits any build, and his 2.0 threes and 1.0 blocks are good for a forward. Early in the season, check his minutes (28 to 29 late last season), his shot volume next to Giannis, and whether his three-point and block rates hold. His weak 10-game playoff schedule makes him a trade chip before the deadline.
